notes:
0.11.6.0
- Heavy reworked: M.M.F.P. upgrades your magazine boxes (up to the new white H.Q. Box), M.M.F.S. fills your team's boxes, Belt Fed gives instant reloads, Fire at will boosts the team's fire rate.
- Sharpshooter: Gauss Rifle rounds per level, Steady Aim pierce, Marked Target can move on, drone vision shared with Sharpshooters.
- Scavenger: every extension passive now works (Scrounger, Combat Boots and more).
- Lobbies: only the same game version can join; the list shows each lobby's version.
- HUD: zombie count / cap at the top.
- Options: "In the background" lets the game run at full speed when it is not in front.
- Lobby screens: the view holds still while a terminal is open, Back buttons everywhere.
